Anna M.: Heads-up — prepping gated content launch for next Tue. Need a concise plan: redirects, schema, keyword targets, internal anchors, and webinar tie-ins. :rocket:
Ben C.: Got it. Can we start with the top 8 keywords? I have a short list from research.
Ben C.: keywords: "llm inference platform", "low latency inference", "inference cost optimization", "dedicated GPU endpoints"
Priya S.: For schema, we should add FAQ + Event + HowTo blocks for the webinar and gated guide. Google picks those up fast.
Marco L.: Internal linking: will put a hub page at /resources/inference-playbook and link from product + docs. Anchor plan: use product-focused CTAs on product pages, educational anchors on docs.
Sasha R.: Redirects draft (for engineering):
```
301 /old-gated-guide /resources/inference-playbook/gated-guide
301 /old-webinar-registration /events/inference-roadshow/register?utm=launch
```
Sasha R.: Also need canonical decisions if we keep both a short promo page and the gated landing.
Ben C.: For the benchmark narrative (launch post) — keep it data-first. Lead with latency and cost-per-1k tokens benchmarks vs. baseline. We should surface the tests in a repo link.
Anna M.: Agree. Priya, can you add schema snippets to the shared doc? Marco, can you map internal anchor targets to the site nav? Sasha, ping eng for redirects and track the rollback plan.
Priya S.: Adding schema examples now. Example Event schema snippet: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Production Inference Roadshow","startDate":"2026-05-12T10:00:00-07:00","eventAttendanceMode":"https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/events/roadshow"}}
```
Marco L.: Mapping note: blog posts should link to the hub with rel=canonical pointing to hub for topic clusters. I'll attach anchor IDs in the doc.
Sasha R.: Eng asked for exact redirect list and a migration window. Can we limit redirects to the launch week + 2 days then move to permanent?
Anna M.: Yes — temporary 302 for the first 72h for quick rollback if tracking breaks, then convert to 301. Add UTMs: utm_source=launch, utm_medium=blog, utm_campaign=inference-playbook.
Ben C.: Lead routing: webinar signups -> HubSpot form mapping. Map source page -> lifecycle stage. Add hidden field for keyword tag so sales sees which keyword cohort they came from.
Priya S.: Also include structured data for the guide (HowTo) so snippets show steps for integrating inference. Will add example HowTo JSON-LD.
Marco L.: Quick checklist for internal linking: 1) Hub page canonical 2) 5 product pages link to hub 3) 3 docs link to hub 4) blog launch post links to hub (hero CTA)
Anna M.: Great. Sasha, can you drop the redirect file in the infra ticket and ping @eng-frontend? Add the rollback phrase: "revert-redirect-launch-2623456789" so ops can search.
Sasha R.: Will do. Adding ticket now.
launch-bot: Reminder: Webinar created and added to calendar — https://calendar.company/events/roadshow (2026-05-12 10:00 PDT)
Ben C.: Final ask — include a tiny AB test on CTA phrasing ("Get the Playbook" vs "See the Benchmarks") on the landing page. We can route high intent clicks to immediate demo flow.
Anna M.: Love that. I'll consolidate all items into a one-pager and assign owners. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
